data.name: Ansa
data.gender_notes: Ansa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Ansa means 'supporter' or 'helper'. In Islamic tradition, it is the name of the wife of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) who helped him during his migration to Medina. The name Ansa carries the meaning “Supporter, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ansa usually hope their child will grow to embody supporter, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of strength and support in times of hardship.
data.etymology: Ansa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supporter, Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ansa total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: أنسا
in_arabic.meaning: أنسا تعني الإنس و اللطف و الحنان
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أنسا مشتق من الجذر العربي أنس، و يعني الإنس و اللطف و الحنان. ورد هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وأنس وجداننا إلى ربنا راغبون'، و في سورة الأنعام: 'أولئك الذين أنسوا الله فأنساهم أنفسهم'، الآية ١٢٨. و يدل الاسم على معاني الوداد و القرب و الزمالة في الإسلام.

in_urdu.name: انسر
in_urdu.meaning: انسر مطلب ہے دوستی، مہربانی، پیار
in_urdu.long_meaning: انسر نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، خاص طور پر جڑ 'أنس' سے جو دوستی، مہربانی، اور پیار کے معنی رکھتا ہے۔ اس جڑ کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں بھی ہوا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ انعام میں: 'أولئك الذين أنسوا الله فأنساهم أنفسهم' (آیت ١٢٨)۔ یہ نام اسلامی روایات میں قرب، مہربانی، اور پیار کی علامت ہے، اور اس کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیاء کے مسلم معاشروں میں عام ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अनसा
in_hindi.meaning: अनसा का अर्थ है दोस्ती, प्रेम, और करुणा
in_hindi.long_meaning: अनसा नाम की उत्पत्ति العربية जड़ों से हुई है, विशेष रूप से 'أنس' जड़ से जो दोस्ती, प्रेम, और करुणा के अर्थ रखता है। इस जड़ का उल्लेख कुरआन में भी किया गया है, जैसे कि सूरह अन्आम में: 'أولئك الذين أنسوا الله فأنساهم أنفسهم' (आयत १२८)। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपराओं में स्नेह, प्रेम, और मृदुता की प्रतीक है, और इसका उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदायों में भी किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: انسه
in_pashto.meaning: انسه د دوستۍ، مينې، او رحم معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: انسه نوم د عربي ريښو څخه اخيستل شوی دی، په ځانګړي ډول د 'أنس' ريښې څخه چې د دوستۍ، مينې، او رحم معنی لري. دا ريښه په قرآن کريم کې هم ذکر شوې ده، لکه څنګه چې د انعام سورت کې: 'أولئك الذين أنسوا الله فأنساهم أنفسهم' (آيت ١٢٨). دا نوم د اسلامي دودونو په مينځ کې د قرب، مينې، او رحم د نښه ده، او په افغان او پښتني دودونو کې کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Ansa
in_english.meaning: Ansa means companionship, love, kindness, and tenderness
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ansa originates from the Arabic root 'أنس' (ans), which signifies companionship, love, kindness, and tenderness. This root is mentioned in the Quran, such as in Surah An'am: 'Those who have forgotten Allah, and thus He has caused them to forget themselves' (verse 128). In Islamic tradition, Ansa symbolizes close relationships, affection, and mercy. The name reflects values of warmth and intimacy, and is used across various Muslim cultures to signify these positive attributes.

pronunciation.pashto: انسه د تلفظ په توګه ان-س-ه دی

data.cultural_impact: The name Ansa holds great cultural significance in Islamic history as it was the name of Khadija bint Khuwaylid, the first wife of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). Ansa provided unwavering support and comfort to the Prophet (PBUH) during his early days in Mecca when he was Desolate, and later on, during the difficult times in Medina. Her name has been passed down through generations as an example of a virtuous wife, a devoted mother, and a passionate supporter of her husband. The story of Ansa and the Prophet's marriage is a reminder of the importance of love, companionship, and support in a relationship.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ansa holds spiritual significance as it represents the concept of support and help in times of hardship. In Islamic teachings, the acts of supporting and helping others are highly encouraged as acts of worship. Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) himself said, "The likeness of good company and bad company is like that of the anvil and the hammer. The anvil is blessed, for it benefits the smith and makes all things shine and glitter, while the hammer destroys and corrupts. Similarly, good company is beneficial to a person and makes him noble, while bad company destroys and corrupts him." (Tirmidhi). In this sense, the name Ansa can be seen as a reminder of the spiritual benefits of supporting and helping others. By living up to the name Ansa, one can strive to be a help and a support for others, both in a worldly and spiritual sense, and therefore contribute positively to their community and to their own growth as a human being.
